## Summary

- [ ] Landing page Past Editions card links to `/docs/2025`
- [ ] All CTA and schedule links on landing page go to `/docs/2026/…`

Closes #5

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

Both findings are confirmed. `src/app/_meta.js` is not in the PR diff so I cannot post inline comments; both blocking/warning findings reference unchanged files or unchanged lines. The synthesis follows.

---

## Summary of PR/Issue

- Migrates all existing workshop content into `src/content/2025/` so it becomes accessible at `/docs/2025/*`, archiving the 2025 edition.
- Creates minimal "Coming Soon" stubs under `src/content/2026/` and makes 2026 the default year in `src/content/_meta.js`.
- Updates the landing page (`src/app/page.jsx`) to show LM4Sci 2026, set Important Dates to TBD, update all CTA links to `/docs/2026/…`, and add a Past Editions section.
- Closes issue #5 (year-based versioning for the recurring workshop site).
- The overall approach is correct and idiomatic for a Nextra-based recurring conference site.

## Review

The year-based versioning design is well-executed and the 2026 stubs are appropriately minimal. However, one blocking regression was introduced: the site nav bar's "Workshop Details" link points to `/docs`, which no longer has a generated page in the static export after this PR moves `index.mdx` into `src/content/2025/`. A one-line fix to `src/app/_meta.js` is required before merging.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Nav "Workshop Details" link will 404 | BLOCKING | `src/app/_meta.js` routes the nav item to `/docs`, but that route has no page in the static export post-move; `href: '/docs/2026'` must be added. |
| Stale 2025 schedule table on 2026 landing page | WARNING | The "Schedule Highlights" section in `page.jsx` still shows hardcoded 2025 time slots while the hero and Important Dates already say 2026/TBD; creates misleading mixed-year content. |
| Old top-level `/docs/*` URLs will 404 | WARNING | Paths like `/docs/call-for-papers`, `/docs/schedule`, `/docs/faq`, `/docs/organizers` no longer exist; external links from email announcements or submission systems will silently break. |
| Missing trailing newline in `src/content/2025/_meta.js` | INFO | `src/content/2025/_meta.js` lacks an EOF newline, inconsistent with `2026/_meta.js`. |
| COLM 2026 date consistency | INFO | All three locations (page.jsx, index.mdx, schedule.mdx) agree on Oct 9, 2026 / San Francisco. No action needed. |

## Progress

- Year-namespaced content structure (`2025/`, `2026/`) and `_meta.js` routing are correctly implemented.
- Landing page hero, Important Dates, and CTA links have all been updated to 2026.
- Past Editions card linking to `/docs/2025` is in place.
- Rubrics review is N/A (no `agent/rubrics` branch exists for this repository).
- No existing inline review threads or comments on this PR.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Nav "Workshop Details" link will 404</summary>

**Cause:** `src/app/_meta.js` declares `docs: { type: 'page', title: 'Workshop Details' }` with no `href` override, so the nav link resolves to `/docs`. Before this PR, `src/content/index.mdx` generated that page. After this PR, that file is `src/content/2025/index.mdx` and `src/content/_meta.js` contains only year-folder entries — `/docs` has no index and no static HTML file is emitted for it. Since `next.config.ts` uses `output: 'export'`, server-side redirects are not available.

**Candidate solutions:**
1. *(Recommended)* Add `href: '/docs/2026'` to the `docs` entry in `src/app/_meta.js` — one line, idiomatic Nextra.
2. Add a thin `src/content/index.mdx` that client-side redirects to `/docs/2026` via a React component — more lines, less clean.

**Comments:** This is the primary site navigation entry point and will break on every page load for every visitor.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Stale 2025 schedule table on 2026 landing page</summary>

**Cause:** The "Schedule Highlights" section in `page.jsx` (lines ~287–358, unchanged by this PR) still contains hardcoded 2025 agenda rows (09:00–10:50 Keynote, 11:05–12:00 Oral, etc.). The PR updated the hero and Important Dates to 2026/TBD but did not touch the schedule table.

**Candidate solutions:**
1. Replace the table rows with a single placeholder line matching the TBD treatment ("The 2026 schedule will be announced closer to the workshop date.").
2. Remove the "Schedule Highlights" section entirely until real data is available.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Old top-level /docs/* URLs will 404</summary>

**Cause:** Content files at `src/content/call-for-papers.mdx`, `schedule.mdx`, `faq.mdx`, `organizers.mdx` have been renamed into `src/content/2025/`. The old routes (`/docs/call-for-papers`, etc.) will no longer be generated as static HTML. The `output: 'export'` setting rules out server-side redirects.

**Candidate solutions:**
1. Accept the breakage (these URLs served the 2025 edition's call for papers period; external references may be stale anyway).
2. Add static redirect pages or Next.js `_redirects` workarounds (complex for a static export).

**Comments:** For a workshop site this may be acceptable — the primary CTA links are already updated and the old URLs typically appeared in announcements targeting 2025 submitters. Evaluate based on whether those links appear in long-lived external indexes.
</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`FIX_PR` — the BLOCKING nav 404 is a concrete, one-line branch change in `src/app/_meta.js` that is safe to automate; the stale schedule table is an adjacent cleanup that can be done in the same pass.

## Final Verdict

`NEEDS_REWORK`

## Action Items

- [ ] Add `href: '/docs/2026'` to the `docs` entry in `src/app/_meta.js` to fix the broken "Workshop Details" nav link.
- [ ] Replace the hardcoded 2025 schedule rows in the "Schedule Highlights" section of `src/app/page.jsx` with a 2026 TBD placeholder.
- [ ] (Optional) Add a trailing newline to `src/content/2025/_meta.js`.

Remaining findings are limited to UX polish and low-impact edge cases that do not affect the happy path. | Issue | Severity | Description | | -- | -- | -- | | `/docs` bare route will 404 | WARNING | `src/content/index.mdx` was renamed into `src/content/2025/`; no MDX remains at the content root, so `/docs` generates no static HTML. Old bookmarks and search-indexed links will hit a GitHub Pages 404. See the full schedule for details." text and "View Complete Schedule →" link remain below the new TBD placeholder row in `page.jsx`, contradicting it — no schedule exists yet to be tentative. | | "Submit Your Paper" label mismatch | INFO | The primary CTA button links to `/docs/2026/call-for-papers` (which says "Coming soon"), but "Submit Your Paper" implies an open submission system. | | Missing trailing newlines | INFO | `src/content/2025/_meta.js` (new file in this PR) and `src/app/_meta.js` (pre-existing) both lack a final newline. | | Stale dead comment in `src/app/_meta.js` | INFO | `// display: 'hidden'` remains on line 12 of `src/app/_meta.js`, unchanged by this PR; it is a leftover from an earlier exploration. | ## Progress - **BLOCKING resolved** — Nav "Workshop Details" 404: `href: '/docs/2026'` added to `src/app/_meta.js`. ✅ - **WARNING resolved** — Stale 2025 schedule rows in `page.jsx` replaced with a single TBD placeholder cell. ✅ - All in-page CTA links updated from `/docs/…` to `/docs/2026/…`. ✅ - Important Dates updated to TBD; Oct 9, 2026 workshop date set. ✅ - Past Editions card added to landing page; links to `/docs/2025`. ✅ - Date/location consistency confirmed: Oct 9, 2026 / San Francisco / COLM '26 is consistent across `page.jsx`, `src/content/2026/index.mdx`, and `src/content/2026/schedule.mdx`. ✅ - Old top-level `/docs/call-for-papers`, `/docs/schedule`, etc. will 404 — assessed as acceptable; all in-page CTAs updated, external links are time-limited. ✅ - No existing inline review threads or inline PR comments on this PR. - Rubrics review: N/A — no `agent/rubrics` branch exists for this repository. ## Issue Details
/docs bare route will 404 **Cause:** `src/content/index.mdx` was renamed to `src/content/2025/index.mdx` and `src/content/_meta.js` now contains only year-folder keys (`2026`, `2025`). With `output: 'export'`, `generateStaticParamsFor('mdxPath')` will not produce `out/docs/index.html`. The primary in-site entry point is fixed (`href: '/docs/2026'` in `src/app/_meta.js`), so no navigation UI leads there anymore. The practical impact is limited to external links pointing directly at `/docs` (e.g., old search engine results, stale social posts). **Candidate solutions:** 1. Accept as-is — practical impact is low; no in-site path remains. Team can monitor for 404s after merge. 2. Add a thin `src/content/index.mdx` with a "Content has moved" message linking to `/docs/2026` and `/docs/2025`. 3. Worth a follow-up issue if search-indexed `/docs` traffic is meaningful.
Stale "tentative schedule" note **Cause:** The paragraph reading "Note: This schedule is tentative and subject to change. See the full schedule for details." and the "View Complete Schedule →" anchor (href updated to `/docs/2026/schedule`) are unchanged lines in `page.jsx`. They sit directly below the new TBD placeholder row, creating contradictory messaging — the note implies a schedule exists to be tentative. **Candidate solutions:** 1. The link target is now correctly year-namespaced, but the label sets a wrong expectation for visitors before the CFP opens. **Candidate solutions:** 1. Change button label to "Call for Papers →". 2. Keep the label but add a visual "Coming Soon" badge or disable the button until CFP is live.
## Recommended Next Step `HUMAN_DECISION` — the remaining WARNING (`/docs` bare 404) and INFO items are all optional UX polish; whether to add a stub, change a button label, or remove a stale note is a product judgment call for the maintainer, not a concrete automated fix. ## Final Verdict `MINOR_ISSUES` ## Action Items - [ ] (Optional) Add `src/content/index.mdx` stub to prevent `/docs` from returning a GitHub Pages 404 for external links and old bookmarks. - [ ] (Optional) Remove the stale "tentative schedule" note and "View Complete Schedule →" link from `src/app/page.jsx` while no 2026 schedule exists. - [ ] (Optional) Rename the "Submit Your Paper" CTA button to "Call for Papers →" until the CFP opens.
